bodyStats.addRecordsHint: Tap the "Add Record" button to start tracking
bodyStats.invalidWeight: Weight must be between 20 and 500 kg
bodyStats.invalidHeight: Height must be between 50 and 300 cm
bodyStats.invalidPerimeter: Perimeter must be between 10 and 200 cm
bodyStats.errorSaving: Failed to save record. Please try again.
bodyStats.bmiInfo: BMI is an approximate measure of body fat based on height and weight. A BMI between 18.5 and 24.9 is considered healthy for most adults. These are estimates; consult a healthcare professional for accurate assessment.
bodyStats.bodyFatInfo: Body fat percentage is calculated using the U.S. Navy method (approximate). This estimate requires neck, waist, and (for women) hip measurements. Always consult a nutritionist or doctor for professional evaluation.
bodyStats.muscleMassInfo: Muscle mass tracking uses perimeter measurements to monitor muscle development over time. These are approximate indicators. For accurate body composition analysis, consult a healthcare professional.
bodyStats.measurementRecommendations: Take all measurements consistently - same time of day (morning recommended), before eating, after using the bathroom, without clothing, using the same measuring tools (scale, tape measure), and in the same conditions each time.
bodyStats.suggestionUnderweight: Your BMI indicates you're underweight. Consider consulting with a healthcare provider about a healthy weight gain plan with proper nutrition and strength training.
bodyStats.suggestionNormal: Great job! Your BMI is in the healthy range. Keep maintaining your balanced diet and exercise routine. Continue monitoring your progress regularly.
bodyStats.suggestionOverweight: Your BMI indicates you're overweight. Consider incorporating regular exercise (cardio + strength training) and a balanced, calorie-controlled diet. Consult a nutritionist for personalized guidance.
bodyStats.suggestionObese: Your BMI indicates obesity. We strongly recommend consulting with a healthcare provider and nutritionist to develop a safe, sustainable weight management plan tailored to your needs.
bodyStats.errorUpdating: Failed to update record. Please try again.
bodyStats.bodyFatMissingMale: To calculate body fat %, add neck and waist perimeter measurements.
bodyStats.bodyFatMissingFemale: To calculate body fat %, add neck, waist and hip perimeter measurements.
bodyStats.bodyFatInvalidMeasurements: Could not calculate body fat %. Check that waist perimeter is larger than neck perimeter.
bodyStats.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this record?
bodyStats.noDataForCharts: Not enough data to display charts. Add more records over time to see your progress.

messages.title: 🛋️ Still on the couch?
messages.body: Your sneakers are judging you. And honestly... they’re right.

messages.title: 🚨 Lazy mode detected
messages.body: Stand up. Move a little. Pretend you're in a Rocky Balboa movie.

messages.title: 🔥 Sweat now, flex later
messages.body: Future you wants abs. Present you wants snacks. Choose your fighter.

messages.title: 🏋️ No drama, just reps
messages.body: You don’t need motivation. You need 10 push-ups. Start there.

messages.title: ⚡ Energy doesn’t magically appear
messages.body: But 20 minutes of moving might make you feel like a superhero.

messages.title: 👀 Yes, this is your sign
messages.body: Stop scrolling. Your workout isn’t going to do itself, champ.

messages.title: 💀 Muscles loading...
messages.body: Warning: results may include confidence, strength, and slight badass energy.

messages.title: 🍕 You ate it. Now earn it.
🧠 Brain fog?
messages.body: Move your body before it turns into mashed potatoes.

messages.title: 🏆 Not a hero yet?
messages.body: Cool. Heroes start somewhere. Usually with sore legs.

messages.title: ⏳ 1% battery, 100% excuses
messages.body: If your phone can survive all day, so can you. Let’s move.

messages.title: 🧃 Pre-workout? Nah.
messages.body: You don’t need magic powder. You need to start. Go.

messages.title: 😤 No one ever said...
messages.body: "Wow, I regret that workout." Exactly. Get up.

messages.title: 🦵 Leg day? Oh boy.
messages.body: Yes, walking tomorrow will feel illegal. Worth it.

messages.title: 🎮 Main character moment
messages.body: This is your training arc. Soundtrack optional. Effort mandatory.
